title: Live With Purpose
coreMove: Turn focus toward a larger direction clear enough to judge what deserves your one thing.
sourcePressure: Part 3 connects focus to purpose as the larger direction that gives the one thing meaning, without letting purpose stay vague.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Letting purpose become inspirational fog or a substitute for hard priority choices.

hook: A single choice changes the whole day
The real priority is hiding under the busy work
Live With Purpose as a generic focus opener
counterintuition: Focus is harder than it looks
tryThisNow: Set a timer and list priorities
Write down your one thing without a concrete context
examples: generic office worker choosing email or strategy

exampleSpecs.stakes: travel demands are exhausting her and delaying care
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she names that her purpose is safe births in remote valleys, then stops accepting distant work that breaks that direction
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a snow-dusted road map beside a prenatal blood-pressure cuff

exampleSpecs.stakes: caseload pressure makes every file feel equal
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he writes the purpose as keeping poor clients from being processed unseen, then changes which hearings receive preparation first
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a courthouse stairwell file box with one client photo clipped inside

exampleSpecs.stakes: cheap bulk deals conflict with local farmer promises
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she asks the board whether the purpose is cheapest shelves or a resilient local food chain before the vote
exampleSpecs.firstImage: two produce invoices laid across a wooden checkout counter

exampleSpecs.stakes: feature requests pull the project everywhere
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she writes that the tool exists to let blind students submit math homework independently and closes unrelated feature tickets
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a screen reader test log beside a raised-line geometry worksheet

exampleSpecs.stakes: renovation ideas threaten the service people trust
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he names the purpose as giving families a steady room on their worst day and drops the flashy lobby plan first
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a folded memorial program resting on a showroom fabric sample book

exampleSpecs.stakes: budget cuts force choices among equipment, outreach, and electives
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she sees that purpose clarified the cut: graduate employable welders before marketing the program more loudly
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a scorched practice coupon beside a cancelled advertising proof

skillTargets: make purpose concrete enough to direct choices

tryThisNowSpec: Write one sentence naming what your current work is in service of, then cross out any phrase that could fit anyone.
